title: Thomas S NDE 6338
content: It was early in the morning at the hospital (7:30 AM.) The nurse in the room asked me if I wanted to sit in the chair prior to breakfast (the day before I had had a ‘fem-pop’ done in my right leg.) [Editor’s note: Femoropopliteal Bypass surgery is used to bypass diseased blood vessels above or below the knee. Heart attack is cited as one of the risks of this surgery.] The nurse aided me in getting into the chair. About three minutes after sitting down in the chair, I felt my eyeballs roll back into my head, and I heard the nurse say to me repeatedly, ‘Mr. Thomas, please do not do this to me.’ The next thing I knew, I was in this beautiful room filled with the most gorgeous white light shining all about. I could feel a loving, comfortable, fearless feeling; and I felt no pain whatsoever. It was easy for me to breathe, and I felt so comfortable. In front of me there was a bed made of stone with beautiful white sheets and a pillow clad in a white pillowcase. I could see the stone corners of the bed. There were three stone steps to climb up to the bed. I started (or at least I thought I did) to push myself up to get into the bed by going up the stone steps. Some type of force kept me back: the force was so strong that I could not even move my shoulders. From the direction of the light source came a voice that said to me, ‘Thomas, you have lived a good life, but I have something even more important for you to do. I do not want you now.’ After that I heard my daughter on the telephone yelling, ‘This is baloney!’ at someone. After that, I looked down and saw a nurse hitting me in the chest and yelling for the paddles. The next thing that I knew, the doctor was there to my right. I asked him, ‘Why is everybody getting so nervous and excited?’ The doctor shouted, ‘He is alive!’ and told me that he was taking me to the operating room. He told me that he was going to do open heart surgery on me immediately. I did not have any sense of time or vision, during the experience. Later I found out that my lungs had collapsed and I had flat-lined.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt eyeballs roll back; then found himself in a beautiful room with loving, comfortable, fearless feeling and no pain.

arrival.other_being_detail: A voice from the direction of the light source spoke to him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Beautiful room filled with gorgeous white light; stone bed with white sheets and pillow; three stone steps.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: A voice said: 'Thomas, you have lived a good life, but I have something even more important for you to do. I do not want you now.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred in hospital the day after a femoropopliteal bypass ('fem-pop'); later found lungs had collapsed and he had flat-lined.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitioned directly from medical crisis to a light-filled room (no tunnel reported), heard a voice giving a mission/return message, then perceived events back in the hospital and returned.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Stone bed with white sheets and pillow; three stone steps; an unseen force prevented him from moving toward the bed.
